question: Who among the following has won the 2020 Pulitzer Prize in the category of fiction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Colson Whitehead**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Colson Whitehead**__

 __
 
• The** list of the 2020 Pulitzer Prize was** out on May 4, and the 15 Journalism and seven Book, Drama, and Music categories were announced.
 
• **American novelist Colson Whitehead won the Pulitzer Prize for fiction **for his** book, The Nickel Boys**. **Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• Whitehead won the honour for the second time.
 
• He had** previously won for Underground Railroad in 2017.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **​Pulitzer Prize 2021**__

 __
 
• **Louise Erdrich won the Pulitzer Prize for fiction for ‘The Night Watchman’. He is America’s most esteemed novelist. The late Les Payne and daughter Tamara Payne for their Malcolm X biography ‘The Dead Are Arising’ is the other book awarded with this prize.**
 
• Pulitzer Prizes awarded a special citation to Darnella Frazier, the teenager who recorded the killing of George Floyd.
 
• The Pulitzer Prizes in journalism were first awarded in 1917 and are considered the field’s most prestigious honour in the United States.
 
 
 
• **Pulitzer Prize**__
 
 
• The Pulitzer Prize is an award for achievements in newspaper, magazine, and online journalism, literature, and musical composition within the United States. 
 
• **First awarded: ****1917**
 
• **Presented by:** Columbia University
